title: Dead-on-Arrival Terms for Hardware Procurement Units
content:
A Hardware Procurement unit that fails out of the box is handled as dead on arrival within the order type's dead-on-arrival window, counted in calendar days after delivery. The remedy and the restocking treatment of a confirmed dead-on-arrival unit, and where a later failure goes, are fixed per order type:

| Order type | Dead-on-arrival window (calendar days after delivery) | Remedy for a confirmed dead-on-arrival unit | No restocking fee on confirmed dead-on-arrival units | Failure after the window handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | 15 | replace or credit | Yes | manufacturer warranty |
| Standard Endpoint Order | 15 | replace or credit | Yes | manufacturer warranty |
| Staged Endpoint Order | 15 | replace or credit | Yes | manufacturer warranty |
| Network Equipment Order | 15 | replace or credit | Yes | manufacturer warranty |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 30 | replace only | Yes | manufacturer warranty |
| Special-Order Equipment | 15 | replace only | Yes | manufacturer warranty |

**Remedy.** Under "replace or credit" a confirmed unit is replaced, or credited at its unit price where the client chooses credit; under "replace only" it is replaced and no credit option exists.

**Window length.** The Server & Storage Build Order alone has a 30-day window; every other order type has 15 days.
